questions.prompt: A resource has platform metrics visible but no resource-operation logs in your workspace. No diagnostic setting exists. What should you configure?

options.text: A diagnostic setting with the required resource log categories and workspace destination.
options.explanation: Resource logs generally require explicit collection/export.

options.text: Only change the metric chart's color.
options.explanation: Chart appearance does not collect logs.

options.text: Only add a resource tag named LogAnalytics.
options.explanation: Tags do not configure telemetry export.

options.text: Only create a DNS alias for the workspace.
options.explanation: DNS aliases do not configure the resource's logging path.

questions.prompt: You need the same resource logs sent to two Log Analytics workspaces. Which diagnostic-settings design is supported?

options.text: Two workspace destinations inside one setting.
options.explanation: A setting supports one destination of each type.

options.text: Two diagnostic settings, each naming one workspace.
options.explanation: Separate settings support multiple destinations of the same type.

options.text: One setting with a comma-separated workspace ID.
options.explanation: The destination field does not represent multiple workspace IDs.

options.text: An NSG rule listing both workspace names.
options.explanation: Filtering rules do not configure log export.

questions.prompt: You need Linux guest Syslog from Azure VMs. Does a resource diagnostic setting alone select their Syslog facilities and severities?

options.text: Yes; AllMetrics contains all Syslog messages.
options.explanation: Metrics are numeric telemetry rather than Syslog messages.

options.text: Yes; the Activity Log contains every guest message.
options.explanation: The Activity Log records management events.

options.text: No; configure a supported guest-agent/data collection rule path.
options.explanation: Guest log collection differs from resource diagnostics.

options.text: Yes; a resource tag sets Syslog severity.
options.explanation: Tags do not configure the guest collector.
